user.title: Health Monitor
user.description: Select the template sensor that should be generated and kept in sync.

options.title: Health Monitor – Monitors
options.description: {rows} monitors configured. Choose an action: generate the template, add by entity or integration, delete monitors – or edit an individual row.

add_entity.title: Add by entity
add_entity.description: Search for and select an entity to add as a monitor. Name and config entry are filled in automatically.

pick_domain.title: Add by integration
pick_domain.description: Select the integration whose entities should be added.

quick_add.title: Quick add: {domain}
quick_add.description: All unmonitored entities are pre-selected. Adjust as needed, or simply submit.

edit_row.title: Edit: {name}
edit_row.description: Adjust the monitor's name or flags. Other fields are preserved.

delete.title: Delete monitors
delete.description: Select the monitors to remove from the table.

refresh.name: Refresh status
refresh.description: Recompute the sync status of the generated template.

resync.name: Resync template
resync.description: Regenerate the template from the table and write it to the target helper.

add_from_entity.name: Add monitor from entity
add_from_entity.description: Add a new monitor row for the given entity. Parameter: target_entity (entity_id to monitor). Name and config entry are auto-resolved.
